Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to replace the mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs to balance the given equation.

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) +, ÷, ×, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 + 25 ÷ 10 × 2 = 175

⇒ 50 + 2.5 × 2 = 175

⇒ 50 + 5 = 175

⇒ 55 ≠ 175

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) −, ×, ÷, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 - 25 × 10 ÷ 2 = 175

⇒ 50 - 25 × 5 = 175

⇒ 50 - 125 = 175

⇒ - 75 ≠ 175

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) −, ×, +, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 - 25 × 10 + 2 = 175

⇒ 50 - 250 + 2 = 175

⇒ 52 - 250 = 175

⇒ - 198 ≠ 175

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) +, ×, ÷, =

Given: 50 * 25 * 10 * 2 * 175

After putting the mathematical sign we get the;

⇒ 50 + 25 × 10 ÷ 2 = 175

⇒ 50 + 25 × 5 = 175

⇒ 50 + 125 = 175

⇒ 175 = 175

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to interchange the signs and two numbers in the following equations to make it correct.

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 10 and 19, - and +

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 19 × 11 - 10 + 323 ÷ 3 = 50

⇒ 19 × 11 - 10 + 107.66 = 50

⇒ 209 - 10 + 107.66 = 50

⇒ 316.6 - 10 = 50

⇒ 306.6 ≠ 50 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 3 and 19, - and ×

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 10 - 11 + 3 × 323 ÷ 19 = 50

⇒ 10 - 11 + 3 × 17 = 50

⇒ 10 - 11 + 51 = 50

⇒ 61 - 11 = 50

⇒ 50 = 50

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 3) 10 and 11, - and ÷

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 11 × 10 + 19 ÷ 323 - 3 = 50

⇒ 11 × 10 + 0.0588 - 3 = 50

⇒ 110 + 0.0588 - 3 = 50

⇒ 110.0588 - 3 = 50

⇒107.0588 ≠ 50

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 10 and 323, + and ÷

Given: 10 × 11 + 19 - 323 ÷ 3 = 50

After interchanging the sign and two numbers we get the;

⇒ 323 × 11 ÷ 19 - 10 + 3 = 50

⇒ 323 × 0.578 - 10 + 3 = 50

⇒ 187 - 10 + 3 = 50

⇒ 190 - 10 = 50

⇒ 180 ≠ 50

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.questionHtml: What was the day of the week on 26th November 1994?
questions.solution:
Calculating the number of odd days in 1994 = 1600 + 300 + 94 years. 1600 years have 0 odd days. 300 years have 1 odd day. 93 years has 23 leap years and 70 normal years which is 23 × 2 + 70 × 1 = 116 Odd days or simply 4 odd days. In 1994, the number of days up to 26th November.

⇒ Jan (31) + Feb (28) + March (31) + April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + Aug (31) + Sep (30) + October (31) + Nov (26) = 330 days ⇒ 330 ÷ 7 = 1 Odd Day.

Total odd days is = 1 + 4 + 1 = 6 Odd days. Cleary, 6 is the code for Saturday.

If a number divisible by 33, then the number is also divisible by 3 and 11

According to divisibility rule of 3,

5 + 2 + A + 6 + B + 7 + C = 20 + A + B + C, so possible values of (A + B + C) = 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25

According to divisibility rule of 11,

5 + A + B + C - 2 - 6 - 7 = 0 or Multiple of 11 ⇒ 5 + A + B + C - 15 = 0 [ taking zero] ⇒ (A + B + C) = 10 we get 0, so, A + B + C = 10

If A = 3, B = 5, C = 2, then 2A + 3B + C = (6 + 15 + 2) = 23

So, The maximum value of 2A + 3B + C is 23.
